title: Chef John's Classic Macaroni Salad
description: Chef John's classic macaroni salad recipe is less sweet than deli-style but this crowd-pleaser is full of colorful veggies and a perfect side for cookouts.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons kosher salt, or more to taste
1 tablespoon white sugar, or more to taste
0.5 cup chopped green onions, white and light parts

steps.text: Whisk 1 cup mayonnaise, vinegar, Dijon, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl until dressing is well blended; whisk in sugar.
Stir celery, bell pepper, carrot, green onions, jalapeño pepper, and poblano pepper into dressing. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until macaroni is ready.

Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain in a colander for about 5 minutes, shaking out the moisture from time to time, but do not rinse.
Transfer macaroni to a large bowl; toss to separate. Cool to room temperature, 10 to 15 minutes. Macaroni should be sticky.
Add celery mixture to macaroni; stir until evenly distributed. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until macaroni absorbs dressing, 4 hours to overnight.
Stir salad; stir water and remaining 1 tablespoon mayonnaise into salad to refresh before serving.

video.description: No summer picnic table is complete without the iconic macaroni salad, and with just a few key steps, this one just might be your best ever. The most important thing is to let your macaroni cool before adding your dressing to insure your dressing adheres properly. Also, in the presence of sweet veggies, the sugar can be cut back for supreme deliciousness. The dressing combines mayo with Dijon mustard, white vinegar, just a tablespoon or two of sugar, kosher salt, black pepper and cayenne. The veggies are green onions, celery, red bell pepper, diced poblano and jalapeno and grated carrot. When everything’s been mixed and cooled, you’ll have a salad that’s full of flavor and color and perfectly paired with anything good from the grill.
